crossRefs.note: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.
Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”
But they don’t know the thoughts of Yahweh, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the…
him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men…
For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which…
Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered…
Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be…

translations.web: However he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.
translations.bsb: But this is not his intention; this is not his plan. For it is in his heart to destroy and cut off many nations.
translations.kjv: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
translations.asv: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off nations not a few.
